text: Loba teori perkara kumaha basa sansakerta muncul. salah sahijina nyaeta ngeunaan  Aryan anu migrasi ti kulon india anu mawa basa anjeunna.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Basa Sansakerta nyaeta basa kuno sareng tiasa dibandingkeun sareng basa Latin anu  diucapkeun di Eropa.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Buku anu pangmimitina nu dikenal di dunya ditulis dina bahasa Sanskerta. saatos pangumpulan Upanishads, bahasa Sanskerta ujug-ujug punah kusabab hirarki.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Basa Sansekerta nyaéta basa anu rumit pisan jeung loba rupina. Basa ieu geus janten sumber loba basa India moderen, sapertos basa Latin nu janten sumber basa-basa Éropa sapertos Prancis sareng Spanyol.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Saatos pertempuran sareng Prancis réngsé, Jérman teras siap-siap pikeun nyerang pulo Inggris.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Jérman nganamian kode serangan éta "Operasi Singa Laut". Seuseueurna pakarang beurat sareng bebekelan Angkatan Darat Inggris leungit pas diungsikeun ti Dunkrik, jadi pasukanna keur rada lemah.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Tapi Angkatan Laut Kerajaan masih kénéh leuwih kuat tibatan Angkatan Laut Jerman (“Kriegsmarine”) sareng tiasa waé ngancurkeun armada invasi naon wae anu dikirim lewat Selat Inggris.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Nanging, ngan sakedik pisan Angkatan Laut Karajaan anu pangkalanna caket rute pertempuran kusabab para laksamana sieun dititeuleumkeun ku serangan kapal udara Jérman.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Hayu urang mimitian sareng penjelasan rencana Italia. Itali utamana "adi" ti Jérman sareng Jepang.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Eta gaduh pasukan anu langkung lemah sarta angkatan laut anu langkung lemah, sanaos maranehanana cik keneh ngawangun opat kapal anyar pas sateuacan mimiti perang.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Tujuan Itali anu utama nyaéta nagara-nagara Afrika. Pikeun nalukkeun nagara-nagara ieu, aranjeunna kedah ngagaduhan tapak peluncuran pasukan supados pasukan tiasa ngaliwat Laut Tengah sareng nyerang Afrika.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Pikeun éta, aranjeunna kedah nyingkirkeun markas sareng kapal Inggris di Mesir. Salain tindakan éta, kapal perang Itali henteu kudu ngalakukeun anu lain.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Ayeuna Jepang. Jepang nyaeta nagara pulau, sami sapertos Inggris.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Kapal selam nyaéta kapal anu didamel pikeun ngalalana di jero cai, sareng tetep cicing di jero cai sababaraha waktu.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Kapal selam dianggo di jaman Perang Dunia kahiji sareng Perang Dunia kadua. kapungkur, kapal sela laun pisan sareng jarak nembak na anu terbatas.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Dina awal perang, aranjeunna seuseueurna ngumbara di luhur laut, tapi nalika radar mulai berkembang sareng janten langkung akurat kapal selam kapaksa lebet kana cai supados teu katingali.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Kapal selam Jérman disebat U-Boats. Jérman pinter pisan dina ngarahkeun sarta ngoperasikeun kapal selamna.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Kusabab kasuksésanna nganggo kapal selam, saenggeus perang urang Jerman henteu dipercaya keur seueur gaduh nukitu.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Leres! Raja Tutankhamun, anu sakapeung disebut "Raja Tut" atawa "Raja Muda", nyaeta salah sahiji Raja Mesir kuno anu dikenal pisan di zaman modern.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Unikna, anjeunna henteu dianggep penting pisan di jaman harita teras henteu dicatet dina daptar raja-raja jaman baheula.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Nanging, papanggihan makamna di 1922 ngajantenkeun anjeunna jadi selebritis, nalika seeur makam kapungkur dijarah, makam anjeunna diantep teu kaganggu.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Seeurna barang anu kakubur sareng Tutankhamun téh parantos dilestarikeun, kalebet  ogé rébuan paninggalan anu dijieun tina logam mulia sareng batu langka.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Penemuan kikiping anu nganggo jari-jari midamel kareta Asyur langkung hampang, langkung enggal, sarta langkung siap kanggo lumpat langkung enggal ti tentara sarta kareta lianna.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Panah-panah nu dongkap dina pamanah téh tiasa nembus acuk zirah prajurit. Pas taun 1000 saacan maséhi, suku Assyrians ngenalkeun pasukan kuda nu kahiji.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Pasukan kuda mangrupiken pasukan anu perang dina kuda. Pelana teu acan kapendak, janten pasukan kuda Assyrian perang dina tonggong kuda tanpa alat nanaon.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Urang sadayana terang seueur politisi, élmuwan, sareng seniman Yunani. Jigana anu paling kasohor dina budaya ieu nyaéta Homer, penyair buta anu kasohor pisan, anu ngadamel dua mahakarya sastra Yunani: puisi Iliad sareng Odyssey.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocles sareng Aristophanes masih jadi panulis naskah populér sareng lakonana dianggap karya sastra pangpentingna di dunya.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Jalmi Yunani séjén anu kawéntar nyaéta matematikawan Phythagoras, paling ka sohor ku teori na anu kawéntar ngeunaan sisi sagitiga katuhu.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Aya babaraha hiji perkiraan tina sababaraha jalmi anu nyarios basa India. Basa India diperkirakeun basa kadua nepi ka opat anu pangseueurna dianggo di dunya.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Jumlah panyatur pribumi bervariasi gumantung kana dialek anu erat patalianana diitung atawa henteu.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Diperkirakeun antara 340 juta dugi 500 juta panyatur jeung sakitar 800 juta jalma tiasa ngartos basa éta.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Basa India sareng Urdu gaduh kamiripan dina kosakatana, tapi béda dina tulisanana; dina paguneman sapopoé, panyatur kadua basa biasana tiasa silih ngartos.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Sakira abad ka-15, Estonia kaler aya di handap pangaruh budaya Jerman.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Sababaraha biksu Jérman hoyong nyaketkeun pribumi jeung Gusti, janten aranjeunna mendakan bahasa literal Éstonia.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Éta téh dumasar karna huruf German sareng 1 karakter "Õ/õ" ditambihkeun.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Sakumaha waktos lumaku, seueur kecap anu diinjeum tina basa Jérman digabungkeun. Ieu mangrupikeun awal pancerahan.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Sacara tradisional, panerus tahta bakal langsung asup kana militér saatos lulus sakola.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Nanging, Charles kuliah di Trinity College di Universitas Cambridge. Manéhna diajar Antropologi jeung Arkéologi, tur Sajarah, jeung meunangkeun predikat 2:2 (gelar kelas kadua handap).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles mangrupikeun anggota kahiji ti kulawarga British Royal anu ngagaduhan gelar.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turki Eropa (bagian Wétan Thrace atanapi Rumelia di Balkan Peninsula) téh 3% ti sakabéh nagara.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Wilayah Turki leuwih ti 1,600 kilométer (1,000 mil) panjangna sareng 800 km (500 mil) lébarna, anu bentukna kirang langkung segi opat.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Daerah di Turki, situ teh nyandak 783,562 kilometer pasagi (300,948 mil pasagi) dimana eta teh 755,688 kilometer pasagi (291,773 mil pasagi) aya di bagean kidul kulon Asia jeung  23,764 kilometer pasagi (9,174 mil pasagi) di bagean Eropa.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Turki ngajadikeun nagarana paling gedé anu ka-37 di dunya, sareng ukuranna satara Metropolitan Perancis sareng gabungan Inggris.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turki dikurilingan ku laut tina tilu sisi: Laut Aegea di kulon, Laut Hideung di kalér jeung Laut Mediterania di kidul.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luxembourg gaduh sajarah panjang tapi tanggal kamerdekaan na ti 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Bagian Bélgia ayeuna mangrupikeun bagian ti Luksemburg di jaman baheula, tapi janten Bélgia saenggeus Révolusi Bélgia taun 1830.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luksemburg parantos teterusan nyobian janten nagara anu teu mihak ka sasaha nanging tetep dijajah dina Perang Dunya I sareng Perang Dunya II ku Jérman.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Di 1957, Luxembourg janten anggota anu mendakan organisasi anu ayeuna mah dikenalna Uni Éropa.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Drukgyal Dzong nyaeta benteng sareng biara Buddha anu tos rubuh dina bagian luhur Distrik Paro (di Kampung Phondey).
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Disebatkeun yén di taun 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel midamel bénténg pikeun pangémut kameunanganna ngalawan pasukan Mongol-Tibét.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Di taun 1951, kahuruan nyebabkeun ngan nyisakeun sababaraha patilasan Drukgyal Dzong, sapertos gambar Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Saenggeus kahuruan, bénténg éta diawétkeun jeung dijaga, dugi ka janten salah sahiji anu paling dipikaresepeun di Bhutan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Salila abad ka-18, Kamboja manggihan anjeunna kacepét di antawis dua tatangga anu kuat, Thailand jeung Vietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Urang Thailand narajang Kamboja sababaraha kali di abad ka 18 sareng di taun 1772, aranjeunna ngancurkeun Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Dina taun-taun pangtungtungna abad ka-18, urang Vietnam ogé narajang Kamboja.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Dina sakumna nu aya di Venezuela, 18% jalma teu didamel, jeung kaseueuran jalma anu gaduh damel didamel dina ekonomi informal.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Dua per tilu penduduk Venezuela daramel di bidang jasa, ampir saparapatna damel di bidang industri sareung saperlimana di bidang katanian.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Industri anu penting kanggo wargi Venezuela nyaéta minyak, dimana nagarana janten pangékspor bersih, sanaos ngan hiji persén anu damel dina industri minyak.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Dina mimiti kamerdékaan negara na, ahli Kebon Botani Singapura tos ngabantu ngarubah pulo nepi ka dayeuh kebon tropis.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Dina taun 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, anggrek hibrida, dipilih salaku kembang nasional nagara.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Unggal taun sakitar sasih Oktober ampir 1,5 juta sasatoan hérbivorangumbara nuju ka dataran belah kidul, meuntas Walungan Mara, ti bukit belah kalér pikeun ngarasakeun hujan.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Teras balik deui ka kalér ngaliwateun kulon, nyebrangan deui walungan Mara, saatos usum ngijih sakitar April.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Di wewengkon Serengeti aya Taman Nasional Serengeti, Area Konservasi Ngorongoro, sareng Cagar Alam Maswa di Tanzania sareng Cagar Alam Nasional Maasai Mara National di Kenya.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Diajar ngadamel media nu menarik ngabutuhkeun kaahlian biasa sareng tradisional, ditambih pakakas anu dikuasai di kelas interaktif (contona papan carita, ngaropéa musik sareng pideo, cara nyarita, jsb.)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Desain anu menarik ngawajibkeun anjeun keur mikirkeun deui anggapan anjeun ngeunaan produksi media sareng diajar keur henteu mikir lurus.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Desain interaktif butuh komponén proyék anu pating nyarambung, tapi ogé kedah asup akal salaku éntitas anu kapisah.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Kalemahan lensa zum téh nyaéta rumitna pokus sareng sajumlah unsur lensa anu dibutuhkeun pikeun nepi ka rentang panjang pokusna jauh leuwih ageung tibatan lensa nu utama.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Ieu ngurangan masalah sabab produsén lénsa ngahontal standar anu langkung dina produksi lénsa.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Ieu nu ngamungkinkeun lénsa zoom ngahasilkeun gambar anu kualitas na setanding sareng lénsa panjang fokus tetap.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Kakurangan lainna tinu lensa zoom nyaeta bukaan maksimum (kecepatanna) lensa na kadang langkung rendah.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Ieu nu matak nyieun lensa jauh mirah sesah dianggo di tempat nu poék tanpa cahaya tambihan.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Hiji masalah anu paling umum nalika nyobaan ngarubah pilem kana format DVD nyaéta pemindaian leleuwiheun.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Seseueurna tipi didamel pikeun dipikaresep ku masarakat umum.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Kusabab alasan éta, sadaya nu anjeun tingal di tipi tos dipotong watesna, luhur, handap, sareng sisina.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Iyeu dijieun jang mastikeun yen gambar nutupan sakabeh layar. Iyeu disebut overscan.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Hanjakalna, nalika anjeun midamel DVD, tepina sigana bakal dipotong ogé, jeung upami videona gaduh terjamahan anu caket pisan ka handapeunna, tarjamahna moal ditampilkeun pinuh.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Kastil abad pertengahan tradisional parantos lila ngainspirasi imajinasi, midamel urang ngabayangkeun olahraga kuda anggo tombak, jamuan pituangeun jeung sopan santun Arthurian.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Sanajan nangtung di sakuriling bangunan ruksak anu geus rébuan taun, geuwat ngingetkeun sora sareng ka ambu aroma pertempuran anu parantos lami. Sareng tiasa ngadangukeun sora suku kuda di jalan anu taringgul jeung tiasa ngaungkeun kasieun anu timbul tina liang jero taneuh.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Tapi emang na imajinasi urang dumasar kana kanyataan? Naha istana diwangun mimitina? Kumaha cara wangunan dirarancang jeung diwangun?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Khusus pikeun periode ieu, Kastil Kirby Muxloe langkung mangrupikeun bumi anu dikubeng ku bénténg tina bénténg anu leres.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Jandela kaca anu ageung jeung témbok ipis moal tahan lila kana panarajang paos nu tos ditentukeun pikeun waktu nu lami.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Dina taun 1480-an, nalika konstruksi dimimiti ku Tuan Hastings, nagara ieu rukun répéh sareng pertahanan ngan diperyogikeun ngalawan gorombolan leutik begal anu sok kukuriling.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Kasaimbangan kawasa nyaéta sistem di mana nagara-nagara Éropa ngusahakeun mertahankeun kadaulatan nasional sakumna nagara di Éropa.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Konsépna nyaéta yén sadaya nagara Éropa kudu usaha nyegah hiji nagara janten kuat, margi kitu pamarentah nasional sering ngarobah aliansi aranjeunna pikeun ngajaga kasaimbangan.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Perang Suksesi Spanyol nandakeun perang mimiti anu masalah utamana nyaeta tentang kekuasaan nu saimbang.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Ieu nandakeun parobahan anu penting, sabab kakawasaan Éropa henteu deui gaduh dalih keur perang agama. Kusabab éta, Perang Tilu puluh Taun bakal janten perang terakhir anu dilabélan perang agama.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Kuil Artemis di Ephesus diancurkeun kaping 21 Juli, 356 SM ku aksi pembakaran nu dilakukeun ku Herostratus.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Numutkeun carita, motivasina nyaéta kasohor ku cara naon waé. Urang Efesus, babari ambek, ngumumkeun yén nami Herostratus henteu partos dicatet.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Sejarawan Yunani satuluyna nyatet ngaranna sapertos anu urang nyaho ayeuna. Kuil dihancurkeun di peuting Aleksander Agung dilahirkeun.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander, salaku raja, nawarkeun diri mayar kanggo ngawangun kuil deui, tapi tawaranna ditampik. Teras, saatos Alexander maot, kuilna diwangun deui dina 323 BCE.

text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Nalika sato nunjukkeun sababaraha kalakuan tertentu disebut polimorfik.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Dorongan-dorongan saraf ieu tiasa dikirimkeun kalawan enggal ka sadaya salira, ieu ngajagi salira supados aman ti sagala anceman.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text_en: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text_en: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text_en: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text_en: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text_en: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text_en: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text_en: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text_en: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text_en: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text_en: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text_en: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text_en: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text_en: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text_en: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text_en: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text_en: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Upami diajar hiji sajarah henteu berarti ngartos ogé soal budayana, tapi sahenteuna ngabantu jelema keur ngarasa dimana anjeunna aya di sajarah organisasi éta.
text_en: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text_en: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Dina perkawis ieu, ngémut conto-conto paripolah wirausaha anu kawit sareng kasuksésan anu dihasilkeun ngabantuan jalmi kanggo kabuka ka parobihan anu anyar sareng arah anyar kanggo garéja lokal.
text_en: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text_en: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: Pola mikir konvergen nyaéta téknik ngaréngsékeun masalah anu ngahijikeun sagala rupa ide atanapi widang kanggo mendak solusi.
text_en: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text_en: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text_en: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text_en: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text_en: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: Sajauh ieu, jelema nyaéta makhluk anu pangpinterna dina maca pikiran nu lainna.
text_en: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Éta hartosna arurang tiasa suksés ngaduga naon anu jalmi sanés tingali, maksudkeun, percaya, nyaho, atanapi kahoyongna.
text_en: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text_en: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: MRI téh dumasar kana fénoména fisik nu disebat résonansi magnétik nuklir (RMN), ieu kapendak kirang langkung di taun 1930 ku Felix Bloch (damel di Universitas Stanford) sareng Edward Purcell (ti Universitas Harvard).
text_en: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Dina résonansi ieu, médan magnet jeung gelombang radio nyebabkeun atom ngaluarkeun sinyal radio leutik.
text_en: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text_en: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text_en: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text_en: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text_en: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Curug Victoria mangrupikeun Kota di Zimbabwe kulon, ngalangkungan wates ti living stone, Zambia sareng caket Botswana.
text_en: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text_en: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text_en: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text_en: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text_en: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Suasana pura anu suram ditambih pemandangan situ Tonle Sap bakal ngadamel pangalaman naék ka bukit moal tiasa dipohokeun.
text_en: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text_en: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text_en: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Yerusalem mangrupiken ibu kota sareng kota panggedéna di Israél, sanaos kaseeuran nagara-nagara anu sanés di PBB henteu ngaku éta ibu kota Israél.
text_en: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Kota kuno di bukit Judean gaduh sajarah anu matak dugi ka rébuan taun.
text_en: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Kota iyeu nyaeta kota suci pikeun katilu agama monoteistik, nyaeta Yahudi, Kristen, jeung Islam. Kota iyeu jadi pusat spiritual, religius jeung budaya.
text_en: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Kusabab kapentingan agama di kota, sareng khususna seueur situs di daerah Kota Lawas, Yerusalem janten salah sahiji tujuan wisata utama di Israél.
text_en: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Yarusalem gaduh seueur situs sajarah, arkéologis, sareng budaya, sareng pusat perbelanjaan anu ramé, sareng rumah makan.
text_en: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text_en: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text_en: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text_en: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text_en: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text_en: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text_en: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text_en: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text_en: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Sateuacan Spanyol sumping dina abad ka-16, Chili kalér aya dina kakawasaan Inca sedengkeun urang pribumi Araucanians (Mapuche) cicing di Chili tengah sareng kidul.
text_en: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Mapuche ogé mangrupikeun salah sahiji kelompok pribumi Amérika terakhir anu mandiri, henteu sapinuhna nyerep kana pamaréntahan anu nganggo basa Spanyol dugi ka saatos kemerdekaan Chili.
text_en: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Sanaos Chili nyatakeun kamerdekaanana di taun 1810 (di tengah Perang Napoleon nu ninggalkeun Spanyol tanpa pamarentahan pusat anu aya gunana sababaraha taun), kameunangan anu nentukeun pikeun Spanyol henteu katepi nepi ka taun 1818.
text_en: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text_en: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text_en: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text_en: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text_en: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text_en: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text_en: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text_en: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text_en: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text_en: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text_en: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text_en: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text_en: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text_en: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text_en: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Janten rélawan sabari liburan téh cara anu mangpaat pisan keur batur, tapi ieu mah sanés perkawis masihan wungkul.
text_en: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Hirup teras janten sukarélawan di luar negeri nyaéta cara anu saé pikeun ngenalkeun budaya sanés, pendak sareng jalmi enggal, ngamahaman diri sorangan, ngahargaan pandangan lain sareng margi meunang kaahlian anyar.
text_en: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: Ieu ogé tiasa janten jalan anu saé pikeun ngalonggarkeun anggaran supados tiasa lami cicing di tempat melancong kusabab seueur padamelan sukaréla anu masihan kamar sareng tuangeun sareng sababaraha tempat ogé masihan gaji sanajan alit.
text_en: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: Viking nganggo jalur laut Rusia pikeun angkat ka Laut Hideung sareng Laut Kaspia. Sabagian jalur ieu téh nepi ka ayeuna masih tiasa dianggo. Pariksa kamungkinan kudu gaduh ijin khusus, anu panginten sesah ditampi.
text_en: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: White Sea-Baltic Canal téh ngahubungkeun Arctic Ocean ka Baltic Sea, ngaliwatan Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga jeung Saint Petersbrug, lolobana dihubungkeun jeung walungan sareng situ.
text_en: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: Situ Onega ogé nyambung ka Volga, janten sumping ti Laut Caspian liwat Russia masih tiasa dilakukeun.
text_en: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Yarakin, keur maneh nepi di pelabuhan sakabehna arek leuwih jelas. Maneh arek kapanggih jeung laleumpang anu narumpang kapal. Manranehna arek mere maneh informasi.
text_en: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Pokokna anjeun bakal masang bewara pikeun nawiskeun bantosan anjeun, wara-wiri di darmaga, ngadeukeutan jalmi anu ngabersihkeun kapal, nyobian keur nyarios ka pelaut di bar, sareng sajabana.
text_en: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Cobian ngobrol ka saseueur-seueurna jalmi . Saatos sababaraha lami, sadaya bakal terang anjeun sareng bakal masihan pituduh ngeunaan kapal anu nuju milari padamel.
text_en: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: Anjeun kedah milih maskapai Frequent Flyer anjeun dina gabungan sareng ati-ati.
text_en: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Sanaos anjeun mikir yén ngiringan maskapai anu anjeun anggo paling seueurna nyaéta intuitif, anjeun kudu sadar yén kaistiméwaan anu ditawarkeun sering béda jeung poin-poin frequent flyer tiasa langkung gampang diala dina maskapai anu béda tapi dina aliansi anu sami.
text_en: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: Maskapai sapertos Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines parantos ngaluaskeun layanana ka Afrika, sareng nawarkeun konéksi ka seueur dayeuh-dayeuh ageung di Afrika kalawan pangaos bersaingjeung maskapai Éropa lianna.
text_en: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: Maskapai Turkish ngalayang ka 39 tujuan di 30 nagara di Afrika ti taun 2014.
text_en: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Upami anjeun gaduh waktos tambahan lalampahan, periksa sabaraha tawaran tarif sadayana lalampahan anjeun ka Afrika sareng tarif lalampahan keliling dunya.
text_en: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: Tong hilap keur nambahan biaya langkung kanggo visa tambahan, pajak indit, transportasi darat, jeung nu sanés. keur sagala tempat di luar Afrika.
text_en: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Upami anjeun hoyong ngapung ngalilingi dunya di Hemisphere Kidul, pilihan penerbangan sareng tujuan na saalit kusabab kurang na rute transoceanic.
text_en: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: teu aya aliansi maskapai anu sanggup nyayogikeun layanan ka 3 benua sakabehna di bumi bagean kidul (jeung SkyTeam teu nyayogikeun pisan dina jalur ieu)
text_en: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Nanging, Star Alliance nyakup kabéh rute kajabi bagian wétan Pasifik Kidul ti Santiago de Chile ka Tahiti, anu mangrupakeun penerbangan LATAM Oneworld.
text_en: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Penerbangan ieu sanés hiji-hijina pilihan upami anjeun badé nyebrangan South Pacific sareng basisir kulon South America. (tingali di handap)
text_en: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Di taun 1994, suku Nagorno-Karabakh Arménia di wilayah Azérbaijan perang ngalawan suku Azeris.
text_en: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Ku ayana dukungan ti Arménia, républik anu anyar tiasa diciptakeun. Nanging, teu aya nagara anu ngaku ieu nagara secara resmi , bahkan Arménia ogé'.
text_en: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: Argumen diplomatik ngeunaan wewengkon eta teras ngarusak hubungan antawis Armenia sarta Azerbaijan.
text_en: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: Distrik Kanal (basa Belanda: Grachtengordel) nyaéta kawasan kasohor abad ka-17 anu ngurilingan Binnenstad, Amsterdam.
text_en: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Sadaya kabupaten ditunjuk salaku Warga Warisan Dunia UNESCO kusabab nilai budaya sareng sajarah anu unik, sareng péta milikana paling luhur di nagara éta.
text_en: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: Cinque Terre anu boga harti 5 bumi, ngandung 5 kampung basisir alit nyaéta Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza jeung Monterosso anu aya dina propinsi Liguria di Italia.
text_en: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Éta teh didaftarkeun dina Daftar Pusaka UNESCO.
text_en: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Salila saabad, jelema geus ngabangun teras di luhur lanskap terjal jeung curam tepat diluhur jurang anu ngahareupan ka laut.
text_en: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Salah sahiji daya tarikna téh nyaéta kurangna pengembangan perusahaan nu katingali. Jalan satapak, karéta, sareng kapal téh anu nyambungkeun kampung-kampung, sareng mobil mah teu tiasa lebet upami ti luar.
text_en: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: Variasi basa Perancis anu dinyarioskeun di Bélgia jeung Swiss téh sakedik béda tina basa Perancis anu dinyarioskeun di Perancis, sanaos duanana sami-sami mirip jeung kedah dingartikeun.
text_en: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: Khususna, sistem penomoran di Bélgia jeung Swiss anu nyarios bahasa Prancis gaduh rada aneh tibatan anu nyarios bahasa Prancis di nagara Prancis, sareng cara ngucapkeuna ogé bénteun saalit.
text_en: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Sanaos kitu, sadaya urang Bélgia jeung Swiss anu nyarios basa Perancis parantos diajar basa Perancis standar di sakola, jadina aranjeunna téh tiasa ngartos anjeun komo upami anjeun nganggo sistem panomeran Perancis standar.
text_en: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Di babaraha tempat di dunya, ngageupayan leungeun nyaeta gestur ramah anu hartina "halo".
text_en: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Tapi, di Malaysia, sahenteuna diantara urang Melayu lembur, éta hartosna "kadieu," mirip jeung curuk anu ditekuk kana awak, sikep anu dianggo di nagara-nagara kulon tertentu, jeung kudu dianggo pikeun tujuan éta waé.
text_en: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Sami ogé, saurang wisatawan Inggris di Spanyol tiasa salah ngartikeun dadah nu ngalibatkeun talapak panangan pas berhadapan sareng nu ngadadahan (tibatan jalmi anu didadahan) salaku tanda pikeun balik deui.
text_en: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: Auxiliary languages nyaeta basa jijieunan nu dianggo keur tujuan ngagampangkeun komunikasi kanggo jalmi-jalmi anu jigana gaduh masalah dina berkomunikasi.
text_en: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Aranjeunna dipisahkeun ti lingua francas, anu mangrupikeun basa alami atanapi organik anu parantos janten dominan pikeun 1 sareng sababaraha alesan minangka cara komunikasi antawis panyatur basa anu sanés.
text_en: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Di beurang anu panas, wisatawan tiasa ningali fatamorgana anu nampakkeun ilusi sepertos cai (atawa benda lainna).
text_en: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Picilakaeun lamun wisatawan ngudag fatamorgana, miceun-miceun energi jeung cai anu sesana.
text_en: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Malah gurun anu pangpanasna ogé tiasa janten tiris pisan upami wengi mah. Hipotérmia nyaéta résiko panggedéna lamun teu nganggo anggoan haneut.
text_en: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Dina usum panas, khususna, anjeun kudu ati-ati kana reungit upami anjeun hoyong naek ka hutan hujan.
text_en: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Sanajan maneh nyetir ngalewatan hutan hujan subtropis, babaraha detik ngabuka panto keur arek asup mobil geus mahi jang reungit jang nyumput asup kajero mobil maneh.
text_en: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: Flu manuk, atawa leuwih dikenal ku flu unggas, tiasa ngainféksi manuk sareng mamalia.
text_en: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Leuwih saeutik ti sarébu kasus dilaporkeun dina manusa, tapi sabagianana parah.
text_en: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Lolobana ngalibatkeun jalma-jalma anu damel ngurus unggas, tapi aya ogé anu résiko pikeun jalmi nun ningalian manuk-manuk.
text_en: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Ciri khas Norwegia nyaéta fjords anu lungkawing jeung gawir anu ngadadak nanjak, kurang langkung sapertos dataran luhur.
text_en: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Dataran luhur ieu sering disebat "vidde" nu hartina tempat lega kabuka, tempat lega nu teu aya bates.
text_en: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: di Rogaland jeung Agder mah maranehna sok nyebut "hei" teh pikeun ngagambarkeun taneuh lapang nu katutupan semak belukar
text_en: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: Glasier téh teu stabil, tapi ngalir turun gunung. Ieu bakal nyababkeun retakan, celah, anu tiasa dihalangan ku sasak salju.
text_en: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: Témbok sareng hateup guha és téh tiasa runtuh jeung retakan tiasa ditutup.
text_en: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Dina tungtung glasier, balok-balok ageung lepas, ragrag sareng tiasa waé luncat atanapi ngagulung salajengna tina tungtung.
text_en: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: Usum turis kanggo stasiun bukit biasana ngahontal penclut na salila usum panas India.
text_en: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Kumaha oge, eta teh boga kaalusan jeung pesona nu beda lamun pas  usum tiis, jeung loba stasiun pasir anu ngagaduhan salju nu loba sareng nawarkeun kagiatan siga ski jeung papan salju.
text_en: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Ngan sababaraha maskapai anu nawarkeun kénéh tarif kapapaténan, anu masihan diskon alit waragad pamakaman di menit ahir.
text_en: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: Maskapai anu nawiskeun ieu jasa kalebet Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa pikeun penerbangan anu asalna ti Amérika Serikat atanapi Kanada, sareng WestJet.
text_en: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Dina sagala kaayaan, anjeun kedah mesen nganggo telepon langsung ka maskapaina.
text_en: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
